title: Pack a tiny adventure.
description: A fictional checklist. Choose your kit and watch your creative prompt change.

outcome.title: Make a pocket expedition.
outcome.body: Step outside with the whole kit. Photograph a detail, sketch its shape, and give your tiny discovery a story.
outcome.explanation: Notebook + Pencil + Camera + Outdoor setting · AND rule

outcome.title: Collect a tiny story.
outcome.body: Photograph one ordinary thing, sketch what the camera missed, and write the caption only you could give it.

outcome.title: Sketch under open skies.
outcome.body: Find a comfortable spot outdoors. Let one page collect a shape, a few words, and a little fresh air.
outcome.explanation: Notebook + Pencil + Outdoor setting · AND rule

outcome.title: Make a wandering field report.
outcome.body: Take a short walk. Pair one photograph with a notebook observation about the place you found it.
outcome.explanation: Notebook + Camera + Outdoor setting · AND rule

outcome.title: Chase a shape outdoors.
outcome.body: Photograph a shape you notice outside, then draw a wonderfully imperfect version beside it.
outcome.explanation: Pencil + Camera + Outdoor setting · AND rule

outcome.title: Sketch something ordinary.
outcome.body: Give a familiar object five minutes of your attention. Its wonky corners count as character.

outcome.title: Make a tiny field report.
outcome.body: Pair a photograph with three notebook observations. Look for something the picture cannot explain on its own.

outcome.title: See it. Sketch it.
outcome.body: Take a photograph, then sketch the same scene from memory. The differences are the interesting part.

outcome.title: Write a sky-side note.
outcome.body: Head outside and record one sound, one color, and one thing you almost walked past.

outcome.title: Draw a little fresh air.
outcome.body: Step outdoors and trace the outline of something nearby. No perfect lines required.

outcome.title: Find a color in the wild.
outcome.body: Take your camera outside. Collect three shades of the same color, from a leaf to a wonderfully ordinary wall.

outcome.title: Catch one tiny detail.
outcome.body: Save a shape, a sound or a stray idea in your notebook. It doesn’t have to become anything yet.

outcome.title: Follow a wandering line.
outcome.body: Let your pencil explore the edge of an ordinary object. Keep the wobbles; they are part of the discovery.

outcome.title: Hunt for a color.
outcome.body: Find three different things in the same shade. A tiny collection, entirely yours.

fallback.title: Bring your curiosity.
fallback.body: No kit required. Step outside and notice something you’ve walked past a hundred times before.
fallback.explanation: No matching kit rule · fallback prompt

emptyBody: Choose any option. Your prompt changes as your kit comes together.
